Implement the following requested change in the repository. Linkify incorrectly parses array arguments Hi. Library version up to 3.1.0 incorrectly parses array and object url parameters: ```python from bleach import DEFAULT_CALLBACKS, Linker text= 'http://test.com?array[]=1¶ms_in[]=2' linker = Linker(url_re=linkifier.URL_RE, callbacks=DEFAULT_CALLBACKS, skip_tags=None, parse_email=False) print(linker.linkify(text)) # prints: http://test.com?array[]=1¶ms_in[]=2 ``` As you see, url is split by [], loosing part of the link. Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and submit the resulting local patch: bleach/linkifier.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
